28:60.text: And whatever you have been given is an enjoyment of the life of
world and its adornment, and that
which is with Allâh is better and will remain forever. Have you then no sense?

28:61.text: Is he whom We have promised an excellent promise
- which he will find true - like him whom We have made to enjoy the luxuries of the life of
world, then on the Day of Resurrection, he will be among those brought up

28:62.text: the Day when He will call to them and say: "Where are My
partners whom you used to assert?"

28:63.text: Those about whom the Word will have come true
will say: "Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray, as we were astray ourselves. We declare our innocence
before You. It was not us they worshipped."

28:64.text: ", and they will call upon them, but they will give no answer to them, and they will see the torment.
if only they had been guided!

28:65.text: will call to them, and say: "What answer gave you to the Messengers?"

28:66.text: Then the news of a good answer will be obscured to them on that day, and they will not be able to ask one another.

28:67.text: But as for him who repented
(in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, then he will be among those who are successful.

28:68.text: And your Lord creates whatsoever He wills and chooses: no choice have they
. Glorified be Allâh, and exalted above all that they associate

28:69.text: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal, and what they reveal.

28:70.text: And He is Allâh: Lâ ilâha illa Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
, all praises and thanks be to Him
. And for Him is the Decision, and to Him shall you
